get.summary:
Support: find claim payments stuck in UF-15791's "partial success" state - posted to ledgers but
never marked posted here - within a bounded time window. This is a bounded but still
cross-partition Cosmos query (Level 1); treat it as a slow, offline-style operation, not a snappy
interactive one. Both bounds are required: without a start bound the query would fan out across
the container's entire history.

parameters.name: ageHours
parameters.description:
End of the window: only include postings at least this many hours old,
    so normal in-flight postings aren't flagged as stuck.

parameters.name: startHoursAgo
parameters.description:
Start of the window: don't look back further than this many hours.
    Must be greater than ageHours.

post.summary:
Support: retrigger posting for a list of confirmed partial-success candidates (e.g. from
GetPartialSuccessCandidates), retaining the original posting's UserId. Each candidate is
re-checked against the live projection immediately before triggering, in case it has already
been resolved by other means since the candidate list was produced.

get.summary: Gets the ordered transfer targets (payer responsibility waterfall) for a charge assembly.

Gets the next transfer target after the current payer assembly in the responsibility
waterfall that covers all of the supplied charges. Targets that do not cover every
supplied charge are skipped. When no charges are supplied, the immediate next payer is
returned (sequence only). Returns 204 No Content when there is no subsequent covering
target.

Gets the full transfer target waterfall for a claim, plus the next covering target for
each charge on the claim. The current payer is derived from the claim's payer
responsibility; next positions are indices into the returned TransferTarget[] TransferTargetListWithNext.TransferTargets
array, or null when no covering target exists beyond the current payer.

chargeId.description: The charge this entry applies to.

position.description:
Index within TransferTarget[] TransferTargetListWithNext.TransferTargets of the next covering
target after the claim's current payer. Null when no covering target exists.

NextChargePosition.description: The next covering target position for a single charge on the claim.

payerAssemblyId.description: Unique identifier of the payer assembly.

payerResponsibilityIndex.description: Position in the waterfall (0 = primary, 1 = secondary, ...).

account.description: Payer account details including type and assistance flag.

coveredCharges.description:
Charges this payer covers. Only evaluated for assistance payers; non-assistance payers
implicitly cover all charges.

status.description: Current status of the payer assembly; always Open for returned targets.

TransferTarget.description:
A payer in the charge assembly's responsibility waterfall. Only Open payer assemblies are
included. Ordered by int TransferTarget.PayerResponsibilityIndex (0 = primary, 1 = secondary, ...).

portfolioId.description: Portfolio this charge assembly belongs to.

transferTargets.description: All Open payer assemblies in responsibility order.

nextChargePositions.description: For each charge on the claim, the next covering target after the claim's current payer.

TransferTargetListWithNext.description: The full transfer target waterfall for a claim, plus per-charge next-target positions.
